metadata.name: hashfox
metadata.description: HashFox — unified paper-trading program (prediction markets, spot, perps, limit orders)

instructions.name: cancel_limit_order
docs: Cancel a pending limit order. Returns locked margin to available balance.

instructions.name: claim_competition_exit
docs: Clear `active_competition` on the user's main account once the
competition has settled, unblocking them to join the next one.

instructions.name: close_prediction_auto
docs: Executor-only auto-close when SL or TP is met on a prediction position.

instructions.name: close_prediction_position
docs: Manually close a prediction position at `current_price` (full exit).

instructions.name: close_trading_position
docs: Manually close an active trading position at `current_price`.

instructions.name: create_competition
docs: Create a new competition. The creator only configures it — they don't
auto-join, and they have no privileged role afterwards. Status starts
as `Pending` and flips to `Active` automatically once `participant_count
* entry_ticket_lamports >= target_lamports` in `join_competition`.

accounts.name: vault
docs: SOL escrow PDA. System-owned account; rent-exempt deposit happens
via `system_program::transfer` on first join.

instructions.name: initialize_user_account
docs: Create the user's unified paper-trading account and credit 100,000 USD
that is shared across prediction markets, spot, perps, and limit orders.
Pays a small real SOL entry fee to the treasury.

instructions.name: join_competition
docs: Join a competition: pay entry ticket → competition vault, init the
per-comp `UserAccount` with 100k virtual balance, mark the user's main
account as in-comp. If this entry fills the target, status flips to
`Active` and `end_ts` is stamped — no creator action needed.

instructions.name: migrate_user_account
docs: One-time migration: reallocates pre-competition `UserAccount`s that
were created before the `active_competition: Pubkey` field was added,
and zero-initialises the new trailing 32 bytes (= `Pubkey::default()`).
No-op on already-migrated accounts.

accounts.name: user_account
docs: predate the `active_competition` field. Validated via the seeds
constraint, which proves the account is the user's own UserAccount PDA.

instructions.name: open_limit_order
docs: Place a limit order (spot or perp). Margin is locked immediately; the
position sits in `PendingFill` until an executor fills it at a
favorable price.

instructions.name: open_market_position
docs: Open a market position (spot or perp), filled immediately at `entry_price`.

instructions.name: report_score
docs: Permissionless: anyone can submit a participant's current `usd_balance`
for inclusion in the comp's running top-3 cache. The PDA derivation of
`comp_user_account` is checked by Anchor (seeds = `[b"comp_user", comp,
owner]`), so there's no spoofing — caller can only submit a real comp
participant's real on-chain balance.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless caller — pays the tx fee.

instructions.name: settle_competition
docs: Permissionless: callable after `end_ts`. Pays 50/30/15/5 from the vault
PDA to top-3 + treasury and flips status to `Settled`. Empty podium
slots route to treasury so funds never get stuck.

types.name: Competition
docs: Onchain trading competition. Holds config, escrow accounting and the
running top-3. SOL escrow is stored on a separate vault PDA so the program
can sign payouts at settle time.

fields.name: name
docs: Fixed-size name (right-padded with zeros). Length tracked separately.

fields.name: start_ts
docs: Stamped on auto-start (when target is reached). 0 while pending.

fields.name: end_ts
docs: `start_ts + duration_secs`. 0 while pending.

fields.name: prize_pool
docs: Lamports collected so far (running tally as users join).

types.name: LeaderEntry
docs: One slot of the top-3 leaderboard cached on `Competition`.

types.name: PredictionPosition
docs: Polymarket-style YES/NO prediction position.

types.name: TradingPosition
docs: Unified spot/perp/market/limit position (crypto + traditional markets).

fields.name: pair_index
docs: Category-scoped asset ID (e.g. Crypto: 0=SOL,1=BTC,...; Stock: 0=AAPL,1=TSLA,...)

fields.name: usd_balance
docs: Unified USD balance (6 decimals). Includes margin currently locked in
open trading positions; available = usd_balance - locked_margin_usd.

fields.name: locked_margin_usd
docs: Margin locked in active/pending trading positions (6 decimals)

fields.name: total_trading_positions
docs: Counter — used as PDA seed for trading positions

fields.name: total_prediction_positions
docs: Counter — used as PDA seed for prediction positions

fields.name: active_competition
docs: Pubkey::default() when not in a competition. Set on `join_competition`,
cleared on `claim_competition_exit` after the comp settles. Enforces
"one active competition at a time" per user.
